purpose: Evaluate bounded ordered endpoint callback delivery and lifecycle fences before implementation.
questions: Identify exact ordering, overflow/gap and lifecycle hazards in the existing observer and bridge; distinguish proven source behavior from the intermittent failure inference.

Review a proposed single persistent async consumer woken by a bufferingNewest(1) signal stream, synchronous lock-protected count/byte-bounded inbox including in-flight ownership, and epoch validation inside the bridge at commit. Which stop/start races or boundedness traps must the coordinator address?

Recommend deterministic barrier/acknowledgment tests for delayed first delivery, excluded middle events, overflow with no later event, retained old callbacks and stop/restart while delivery is held. No native EndpointSecurity activation or real user data.
